description: This file contains functions for configuring and managing DHCP client behavior within a network interface configuration system. It includes initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown routines, as well as adding DHCP options and handling protocol parameters.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCP protocol configuration variables and options.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_add_sendopts
methods.description: Appends DHCP send options if provided.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCP client with specified configuration, preparing and executing the udhcpc command.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_renew
methods.description: Signals udhcpc to renew the DHCP lease via SIGUSR1.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_teardown
methods.description: Kills the udhcpc process to teardown DHCP lease.
